permittedChanges.P1: Replace the handoff fixture rows with verified rows returned by the report's parameter-bound queries.
permittedChanges.P2: Render the published departement geometry with the simplification tolerance recorded in Design decisions, applied in the report's row mapping, in place of the review outlines.
permittedChanges.R1: Add a constant-dollar curve to the dollar-GDP chart (approver, 2026-09-25).
permittedChanges.R2: Drop PPS per inhabitant from the departement section (approver, 2026-09-25).
permittedChanges.A1: Differences listed to the approver on 2026-09-25 and accepted by them in chat the same day.

differencesFromHandoff.difference: Plots are drawn at the width their container measures instead of the artboard's fixed 1188 px; heights, margins and every vertical geometry are the artboard's.
differencesFromHandoff.reason: Responsive production layout; the artboard fixes one width.

differencesFromHandoff.difference: Rows come from the report's parameter-bound queries instead of the canvas data script.
A figure whose dataset's pipeline is suspect, stale or failed carries a named cue with a shape above its body, and the header carries the qualification line.
differencesFromHandoff.reason: The States artboard specifies the cue's wording and shape but not its placement in the ready report; this places it where the artboard's banner sits, above the figure.

differencesFromHandoff.difference: PPS per inhabitant is removed from the value strip and the data table.
differencesFromHandoff.reason: Requested by the approver on 2026-09-25: within France PPS is the euro figure times one constant, so it adds nothing to a comparison between departements.

differencesFromHandoff.difference: The visual is registered as index-choropleth instead of the handoff's departement-choropleth, because a different visual with that ID already exists.
Boundaries are the published IGN geometry simplified in the report's row mapping at the recorded tolerance, projected by the visual.
The source line reads 'simplified for display' instead of 'simplified for this review prototype'.
The data table lists every departement; those with no figure for the shown year follow the ranked ones with '—'. The artboard's summary 'sortable in production' is dropped.
differencesFromHandoff.reason: The row spine is every boundary; the table is not sortable.

differencesFromHandoff.difference: The prototype footer line 'Review prototype — representative runtime only' is removed.
differencesFromHandoff.reason: It describes the prototype, not the report.

differencesFromHandoff.difference: At viewports below about 1335 px the OECD reference chip wraps to a second line of the control row.
differencesFromHandoff.reason: At 1280 px the artboard's compare field overflowed its own row by about 40 px, which the canvas hid; the page wrapper leaves this report 16 px less.
